metadata.title: Pass 3 reference table — Dionaea muscipula trigger-hair mechanotransduction, action potential propagation, two-touch Ca2+ counting memory, and electro-mechanical closure latency
metadata.note: Literature values below were recalled offline during the Pass 3 remediation (no network access); every DOI and every numeric value is flagged with its provenance and should be verified online before being treated as a digitised figure/table value. Rows with provenance 'model' are modelling choices of this script, not literature values.

governing_equations.monodomain_cable_fhn: dV/dt = D lap V + [V (V - a)(1 - V) - beta_w w] / tau_v ;  dw/dt = (V - gamma w) / tau_w  (P1 finite elements on the lobe planform, IMEX time stepping)
governing_equations.nagumo_front_speed: c = sqrt(2 D / tau_v) (1/2 - a)  (exact travelling-front speed of the bistable cubic cable equation; McKean 1970)
governing_equations.trigger_hair_boltzmann: P_open(F) = 1 / (1 + exp(-(F - F_half)/F_slope)) ;  V_rec = gain * P_open(F)
governing_equations.calcium_counter: Ca_i(t) = sum_k c * exp(-(t - t_k - T_act,k(i)) / tau_Ca) * H(t - t_k - T_act,k(i)) ;  motor tissue active where Ca_i >= 1
governing_equations.two_touch_memory_window: Delta_max = tau_Ca * ln(c / (1 - c))  for 1/2 <= c < 1
governing_equations.gated_active_rest_curvature: d kappa_x0/dt = (k_init + (kx0_final - k_init) A(t) - kappa_x0) / tau_a ;  A(t) = lumped-mass area fraction of activated nodes

model_parameters.name: AP_DIFFUSIVITY_CM2_S
model_parameters.note: electrotonic diffusivity D = lambda^2/tau_m; chosen so that c = 9.8 cm/s lies in the Hodick & Sievers (1988) 6-20 cm/s range

model_parameters.name: AP_TAU_W_S
model_parameters.note: with gamma = 0.5 and beta_w = 0.1 gives ~1.5 s half-amplitude AP duration

model_parameters.name: TRIGGER_HAIR_F_HALF_UN
model_parameters.note: Scherzer et al. 2019 report micronewton-scale detection thresholds; exact half-activation value is a model choice

model_parameters.name: TRIGGER_HAIR_FOOTPRINT_CM
model_parameters.note: must exceed the 2D critical nucleus radius ~ D/c for all-or-none initiation

model_parameters.name: CA_INCREMENT_PER_AP
model_parameters.note: 1 AP < threshold <= 2 APs (Böhm et al. 2016 counting rule)

model_parameters.name: LOBE_TRIGGER_HAIRS_REL
model_parameters.note: three trigger hairs per lobe arranged in a triangle (count is literature; positions are a model placement)

literature_reference_values.name: ap_conduction_velocity_cm_s
literature_reference_values.note: Volkov et al. (2008) report a much faster (~10 m/s) and shorter AP; this table follows the Hodick & Sievers / Hedrich & Neher convention

literature_reference_values.name: ap_count_required_for_closure
literature_reference_values.source: Böhm et al. (2016) Curr Biol 26:286-295; Suda et al. (2020) Nat Plants 6:1219-1224

literature_reference_values.name: two_touch_memory_window_s
literature_reference_values.source: Volkov et al. (2008) Plant Physiol 146:694-702 (electrical memory); Suda et al. (2020) Ca2+ decay

literature_reference_values.name: closure_latency_after_second_touch_s
literature_reference_values.source: Volkov et al. (2008) Plant Physiol 146:694-702; Forterre et al. (2005) ~100 ms closure

literature_reference_values.name: nagumo_front_speed_cm_s_at_defaults
literature_reference_values.source: c = sqrt(2 D / tau_v)(1/2 - a) with D = 1.5, tau_v = 0.005, a = 0.1
